title.narrative: Municipal Project Support Facility (MPSF)

description.narrative: The Facility will be available for the support of municipal investment projects, in particular those addressing the objectives of the Covenant of Mayors. The MPSF would provide continuous support from project identification, through project preparation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation/reporting phase, thus accompanying the project through its entire cycle.
